title: Largest rectangle in a histogram
statement:
Bars of width 1 have heights h. Return the area of the largest rectangle that fits under the histogram.

Constraints: up to 10⁵ bars.
hints: For each bar as the shortest bar of a rectangle, how far can it extend left and right?
The bounds are the previous and next smaller bars: a monotonic increasing stack finds both. Append a 0 to flush the stack.

solution.explanation: The best rectangle has some bar as its shortest; that bar extends until the nearest strictly smaller bar on each side. Keep a stack of (start, height) with increasing heights. When a shorter bar arrives, pop taller bars: each popped bar's rectangle ends here and started at its recorded start; the new bar inherits the leftmost popped start. A sentinel 0 at the end pops everything. O(n), one of the most-asked hard problems.
